title: Frontend Engineer Mastery Roadmap
summary: Deepen core front‑end expertise, build professional‑grade projects, and prepare for hiring. Follow the four phases to move from solid fundamentals to a polished portfolio and job readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Solidify the building blocks of web markup, styling, and scripting.

milestones.title: JavaScript Essentials
milestones.outcome: Can write modern ES6+ code for DOM manipulation and data handling.

tasks.title: Read ES6 features guide
tasks.description: Study the ES6 overview on MDN covering let/const, arrow functions, and modules.

tasks.title: Manipulate DOM elements
tasks.description: Write a script that adds, removes, and updates list items on a page.

tasks.title: Fetch data from API
tasks.description: Use fetch to retrieve JSON from a public API and display results.

tasks.title: Debug with console
tasks.description: Practice using console.log and breakpoints to troubleshoot the script.

tasks.title: Summarize learning
tasks.description: Record a short summary of key JavaScript concepts learned.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Gain expertise in typed JavaScript, React, accessibility, and performance.

milestones.title: Performance Optimization
milestones.outcome: Can measure, analyze, and improve page load and runtime performance.

tasks.title: Read Web Vitals guide
tasks.description: Study the Web Vitals documentation on web.dev to learn key metrics.

tasks.title: Profile page with Lighthouse
tasks.description: Run Lighthouse audit on a sample page and record scores.

tasks.title: Implement lazy loading
tasks.description: Add lazy loading to images and code-split a React route.

tasks.title: Optimize CSS delivery
tasks.description: Inline critical CSS and defer non‑essential styles.

tasks.title: Reflect on impact
tasks.description: Write a short note on how the changes affected performance scores.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create real‑world portfolio pieces that showcase depth and best practices.

milestones.title: Component Library
milestones.outcome: Can design reusable, documented UI components with testing.

tasks.title: Define component list
tasks.description: List 5 core UI components (button, modal, card, tooltip, input).

tasks.title: Build Button component
tasks.description: Create a customizable Button in React+TS with variants and docs.

tasks.title: Write Storybook stories
tasks.description: Set up Storybook and add stories for each component.

tasks.title: Add unit tests with Jest
tasks.description: Write tests covering props, events, and accessibility for Button.

tasks.title: Publish to npm (private)
tasks.description: Configure package.json and publish the library to a private npm registry.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Refine advanced skills, adopt professional habits, and launch the job search.

milestones.title: Accessibility & Performance Audits
milestones.outcome: Can evaluate any site for WCAG compliance and performance bottlenecks.

tasks.title: Run axe audit on portfolio
tasks.description: Execute axe on each portfolio project and fix remaining issues.

tasks.title: Benchmark with WebPageTest
tasks.description: Measure load times and identify slow resources for each site.

tasks.title: Write audit report
tasks.description: Create a short PDF summarizing accessibility and performance findings.

tasks.title: Share report with mentor
tasks.description: Send the audit report to a senior engineer for feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on improvements
tasks.description: Note how the fixes changed user experience and metrics.
